standard_description: Engine Coolant Temperature - Data Valid But Above Normal Operational Range (Most Severe)
source_interpretation: Engine cooling circuit overheating. Thermostat, coolant leak, or radiator blockage likely.

standard_description: Engine Oil Pressure - Data Valid But Below Normal Operational Range (Least Severe)
source_interpretation: Oil pressure slightly below nominal threshold. May indicate thinning oil or sensor degradation.
